overall_notes: The paper focuses on code simplification for computational efficiency, with NLG evaluation (code summarization) as one of the downstream tasks. Automatic metrics are used to evaluate the summarization outputs. LLM (GPT-4o) is used for zero-shot generation, not as a judge. Extraction quality is generally good but needed normalization and clarification on task categorization.
